name: Atari S.A.
summary: Atari S.A. is a global entity specializing in interactive entertainment and product licensing across diverse platforms. Its operations encompass the creation and monetization of video games through various channels, multimedia content production, and managing licensing agreements. The company also offers the Atari VCS gaming console and is active in the blockchain space, developing non-fungible tokens (NFTs) and fostering an ecosystem around its proprietary Atari Token. It boasts a substantial portfolio, overseeing approximately 200 game titles and franchises, including iconic names such as Asteroids, Centipede, Missile Command, Pong, and RollerCoaster Tycoon. Established in Paris, France, in 1972, the firm was formerly known as Infogrames Entertainment SA before rebranding to Atari S.A. in May 2009.
